items.html: And what was already clarified of them became the Hod, Yesod, and Malchut of ZA, and came out with him when he was born. And through the milk these parts expanded in their place in ZA, and ZA was a son of complete VAK. For at first, in the Ibur, only the three middles were clarified in him completely, and the three lower ones were clarified somewhat, in the secret of their inclusion within the three others, in the secret of three included in three, as above. And when the three lower ones finished being clarified, then they did not need to be included above, and they expanded, and he was completed in complete VAK. And this is the secret that was explained: that at the time of Yenika he has VAK. And understand this.
